INSERT INTO HSBA010T_TBL (CMPYCD, ITEMCD, ITEMNM, ITEMENM, ITSIZE, UNIT, UNITNM, INUNIT, INUNITNM, ICQTY, OUTUNIT, OUTUNITNM, OCQTY, SETYN, ASTKIND, AGRPCD, BGRPCD, IMPRICE, OMPRICE, STOCK, QTYPNT, VATYN, SOTAXYN, UDOGYN, BARCODE, HSCODE, REMARK, USEYN, IN_CUSTCD, AUTOYN, ADDTIME, UPDTIME, UPDEMP) VALUES (#{cmpycd}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{itemcd}, ''), CONCAT( CASE #{astkind} WHEN '100' THEN 'R' WHEN '110' THEN 'A' WHEN '111' THEN 'B' WHEN '120' THEN 'G' WHEN '200' THEN 'P' WHEN '210' THEN 'W' WHEN '900' THEN 'S' WHEN '910' THEN 'S' ELSE 'G' END, LPAD(IFNULL((SELECT MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(x.ITEMCD, 2, 6) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM HSBA010T_TBL x WHERE x.CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND SUBSTRING(x.ITEMCD, 1, 1) = CASE #{astkind} WHEN '100' THEN 'R' WHEN '110' THEN 'A' WHEN '111' THEN 'B' WHEN '120' THEN 'G' WHEN '200' THEN 'P' WHEN '210' THEN 'W' WHEN '900' THEN 'S' WHEN '910' THEN 'S' ELSE 'G' END), 0) + 1, 6, '0') )), #{itemnm}, #{itemenm}, #{itsize}, #{unit}, (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{unit}), #{inunit}, (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{inunit}), IFNULL(#{icqty}, 0), #{outunit}, (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{outunit}), IFNULL(#{ocqty}, 0), #{setyn}, #{astkind}, #{agrpcd}, #{bgrpcd}, IFNULL(#{imprice}, 0), IFNULL(#{omprice}, 0), IFNULL(#{stock}, 0), IFNULL(#{qtypnt}, 0), IFNULL(#{vatyn}, 'N'), IFNULL(#{sotaxyn}, 'N'), IFNULL(#{udogyn}, 'N'), #{barcode}, #{hscode}, #{remark}, #{useyn}, #{in_custcd}, IFNULL(#{autoyn}, 'N'), NOW(), NOW(), #{updemp});
SELECT 'OK' AS RESULT, '' AS MSG;

UPDATE HSBA010T_TBL SET ITEMNM = #{itemnm}, ITEMENM = #{itemenm}, ITSIZE = #{itsize}, UNIT = #{unit}, UNITNM = (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{unit}), INUNIT = #{inunit}, INUNITNM = (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{inunit}), ICQTY = #{icqty}, OUTUNIT = #{outunit}, OUTUNITNM = (SELECT UNITNM FROM HSBA040T_TBL WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND UNIT = #{outunit}), OCQTY = #{ocqty}, SETYN = #{setyn}, ASTKIND = #{astkind}, AGRPCD = #{agrpcd}, BGRPCD = #{bgrpcd}, IMPRICE = #{imprice}, OMPRICE = #{omprice}, STOCK = #{stock}, QTYPNT = #{qtypnt}, VATYN = #{vatyn}, SOTAXYN = #{sotaxyn}, UDOGYN = #{udogyn}, BARCODE = #{barcode}, HSCODE = #{hscode}, REMARK = #{remark}, USEYN = #{useyn}, IN_CUSTCD = #{in_custcd}, AUTOYN = #{autoyn}, UPDTIME = NOW(), UPDEMP = #{updemp} WHERE CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND ITEMCD = #{itemcd};
SELECT 'OK' AS RESULT, '' AS MSG;

SELECT A.CUSTCD, A.CUSTNO, A.CUSTNM, A.CUSTGBN, A.BOSSNM, A.JUMINNO, A.LEGALNO, A.CUSTKIND, A.CUSTTYPE, A.TELNO, A.FAXNO, A.POSTNO, A.ADDRESS, A.D_ADDRESS, A.IOGBN, J.CODENM AS IOGBNNM, IFNULL(B.INPRCGBN,'000') AS INPRCGBN, IFNULL(B.OUTPRCGBN,'000') AS OUTPRCGBN, IFNULL(B.HDAMT,0) AS HDAMT, IFNULL(B.RCVDD,0) AS RCVDD, IFNULL(B.AGRPCD,'000') AS AGRPCD, IFNULL(B.BGRPCD,'000') AS BGRPCD, IFNULL(B.CGRPCD,'000') AS CGRPCD, IFNULL(B.AREA,'000') AS AREA, B.DAMDANG AS CDAMDANG, B.TELNO AS CTELNO, B.EMAIL AS CEMAIL, B.REMARK, C.CDNM AS INPRCGBNM, D.CDNM AS OUTPRCGBNM, E.CDNM AS AGRPNM, F.CDNM AS BGRPNM, G.CDNM AS AREANM , A.STATUS, I.CODENM AS STATUSNM, A.USEYN, A.BANKNM, A.GUJOA, A.FNDYMD, A.STDYMD, A.CLSYMD, A.SINGRD, K.CODENM AS CUSTGBNM, A.ELCYN, A.GIGBCD, A.OUTCUSTCD FROM HABA020T_TBL A LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA100T_TBL B ON A.CMPYCD = B.CMPYCD AND A.CUSTCD = B.CUSTCD LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL C ON B.CMPYCD = C.CMPYCD AND B.INPRCGBN = C.CODE AND C.CDGBN = '200' LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL D ON B.CMPYCD = D.CMPYCD AND B.OUTPRCGBN = D.CODE AND D.CDGBN = '200' LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL E ON B.CMPYCD = E.CMPYCD AND B.AGRPCD = E.CODE AND E.CDGBN = '400' LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL F ON B.CMPYCD = F.CMPYCD AND B.BGRPCD = F.CODE AND F.CDGBN = '410' LEFT OUTER JOIN HSBA900T_TBL G ON B.CMPYCD = G.CMPYCD AND B.AREA = G.CODE AND G.CDGBN = '430' LEFT OUTER JOIN HABA900T_TBL I ON A.STATUS = I.CODECD AND I.CDTYPE = '280' LEFT OUTER JOIN HABA900T_TBL J ON A.IOGBN = J.CODECD AND J.CDTYPE = '340' LEFT OUTER JOIN HABA900T_TBL K ON A.CUSTGBN = K.CODECD AND K.CDTYPE = '270' WHERE A.CMPYCD = #{cmpycd} AND A.CUSTCD >= #{custcd} AND A.STATUS in ('010','020','030') ORDER BY A.CUSTCD
